about_the_game:
The light has lost.
The final magic war ended in silence, leaving only creeping shadows to devour the world piece by piece.
Before the last light faded, the Mages of Light sent a handful of survivors — including you — into an unknown land teeming with monsters, mysteries, and a flicker of hope.

Shinebringers is a co-op survival game for up to 4 players.
You are apprentice mages with barely any magic left — and a few allies you must rely on.
Explore, gather, and fight to stay alive.
But be warned: magic can save you… if you know how to use it.

This is the story of ordinary survivors who must depend on one another.
If you survive, the light might return.
If you fall, the darkness will claim everything.

Features

  • Survive together – Gather, craft, and help each other make it through

  • Tactical spell combat – Choose the right spells for the right moments

  • A world of danger and mystery – Every corner hides a resource that could save you… or something that wants to eat you

  • Growth and discovery – Develop your magic and uncover the truth behind the war

If you love playing with friends, facing the unknown, laughing through chaos, and overcoming the odds together —
Shinebringers might just be the game you’ve been waiting for.

content_descriptors.notes:
Shinebringers features mild fantasy violence and occasional depictions of magical combat, including visual effects that represent elemental attacks (fire, lightning, etc.). Some enemies may resemble undead creatures or shadowy beasts, but there is no graphic gore or realistic blood. The tone of the game is dark and mysterious, involving themes of survival, loss, and trust.

There is no nudity, sexual content, or substance use in the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 10400, AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 (6G VRAM), AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6G VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: intel i7 12700k, AMD Ryzen 7 7800x3D
  • Memory: 12 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 (8G VRAM), AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT (16GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 MB available space

short_description: You are the final spark of hope. Team up with your friends, wield magic, and survive a world swallowed by darkness — together.
